assessment: Fixed-grid software and output contracts passed. Luminosity-normalized ILC comparisons and matched LL controls support the overall physical scale, with model-dependent residuals. LEP endpoint disagreement and field-domain/statistical convergence remain open. Revised peak-width analysis resolves histogram advisories without qualifying fitted response widths or accelerator convergence.
limitations: LEP azimuth-bin FeeBL SEM remains about 7.9 times the estimated reference uncertainty at the median. The endpoint excess persists after independent primary-vector digitization and bin-map checks.
ILC production comparisons use effective daughter cross sections N/L_ee with full joint covariance. BW/BH and LL residuals remain; GP and CAIN use different virtuality prescriptions.
Published pair Monte Carlo errors and luminosity uncertainty are unspecified. The fixed-luminosity Var(N)=2N reference scenario, with N and 4N variants, does not establish calibrated significance.
HALHF reference pixels describe occupied support, not normalized density or yield. Support overlap is not a calibrated significance.
Main-grid visit/stencil rejection maxima are not lost charge. Particle, mesh, slice, time and field-domain convergence remain separate requirements.

The LL controls have four matched seeds and three variance degrees of freedom. EPA-ring LL SEM is 0.0961 mb, with leave-one-out range 0.0214-0.1333 mb; exact-local SEM is 0.1085 mb, with range 0.0479-0.1542 mb.
The fixed-resolution FWHM analysis reuses saved spectra. Bin-alignment envelopes are numerical sensitivities, not statistical confidence intervals; FCC-ee scan points still have one seed each.
Adaptive mode 4 remains unqualified after strict exit code 8. Native studies retained fixed-grid scalar settings.

lep.assessment: Plausible mean scale; distribution refinement required

ilc.observable: Effective individual-daughter production cross section in mb
ilc.normalization: For every BW/BH/LL channel, sum of admitted electron and positron counts divided by sum of inclusive electron-positron luminosity; 1 mb=1e-31 m^2.
ilc.selection: 5 MeV production cut per daughter; pair_ratio=1; no final-energy recut, scattered spectators or other secondary populations.
ilc.uncertainty: Full joint count/luminosity covariance of the mean; all interchannel terms retained; delete-one-collision jackknife; no added row-Poisson term.
ilc.reference_error_scenario: Var(N)=2N at one equivalent crossing and fixed published L_ee=1.82 inverse microbarn, not source-certified historical errors.

model1.estimator: Ratio of summed daughter counts to summed electron-positron luminosity
model1.covariance: Jacobian of the complete joint seed covariance of the mean

model2.estimator: Ratio of summed daughter counts to summed electron-positron luminosity
model2.covariance: Jacobian of the complete joint seed covariance of the mean

ilc.reference_total_convention: Totals sum printed channel cross sections (57.95 and 50.74 mb); independently rounded source totals are 58.0 and 50.7 mb.
ilc.raw_counts_role: Per-crossing detector-background diagnostics remain in the native/reduction products; they are not the current source comparison.
ilc.assessment: Normalized LL is 1.88% below GP; BW/BH are 7.15%/3.94% above GP. Plausible scale with explicit model and convergence limitations; precision reproduction is not established.

grid_metric_interpretation: Maxima across recorded visits/stencils in each campaign family, not integrated lost-charge fractions

ll_controls.normalization: Ratio of summed admitted daughter counts to summed inclusive electron-positron luminosity
ll_controls.model_scope: All arms use unpolarized real photons. Legacy EPA already has corrected Born normalization. Full-QED BH/LL do not use the EPA hard pair_q2 veto.
ll_controls.population_scope: Admitted electron/positron daughters only; 5 MeV production cut, pair_ratio=1, no final recut and no scattered spectators. Exact daughter assignment follows the minimum-virtuality spectator rule.
ll_controls.domain_scope: Expanded extents change field/source coverage and virtual-photon acceptance together, at fixed transverse cell spacing. beam_size=0 places photons locally; it does not model infinite beams.

paired_changes.label: EPA refinements
paired_changes.definition: Finite-mass flux, alpha-constant adjustment and stable angular sampler together; the Born normalization is already corrected in both arms.

paired_changes.label: EPA spatial profile
paired_changes.definition: Change the transverse placement prescription at fixed finite-mass EPA treatment.

paired_changes.label: Full treatment, ring
paired_changes.definition: Change hard amplitudes, proposal support, exact kinematics, virtuality and identical-lepton treatment together; the common placement rule does not imply an identical sampled spatial distribution.

paired_changes.label: Full treatment, profile
paired_changes.definition: Change the full hard-process and phase-space treatment while retaining the profile placement rule.

paired_changes.label: Full-QED spatial profile
paired_changes.definition: Change the placement prescription within the full-QED calculation.

paired_changes.label: Electron-mass cutoff
paired_changes.definition: Apply Q squared no greater than electron mass squared within EPA; this does not implement the complete CAIN spatial model.

paired_changes.label: Remove suppression, EPA
paired_changes.definition: Disable finite transverse beam-size suppression within EPA.

paired_changes.label: Remove suppression, full
paired_changes.definition: Disable finite transverse beam-size suppression within full QED.

paired_changes.label: Expand domain
paired_changes.definition: Double both transverse extents and cell counts while keeping cell spacing fixed.

model_profile_interaction.label: Model/profile interaction
model_profile_interaction.definition: (full profile - full ring) - (EPA profile - EPA ring)
model_profile_interaction.qualification: Difference-in-differences with measured paired covariance; controls need not be additive.

ll_controls.qualification: All controls retained. Changes are conditional and non-additive; the model/profile interaction is 0.2830 +/- 0.0815 mb for LL. No new LL kernel defect is established. Four seeds and one domain enlargement do not certify precision convergence.

figure2_LEP_digitization.interpretation: No significant digitization or bin-mapping error explains the 25.5-26 microradian excess. Further physical/numerical investigation and independent-field precision are needed.

selection.rule: Odd seeds for CPU, even seeds for GPU; fixed without selecting on outcomes.

figure7_CPU_GPU.matched_seed_closure: Eight CPU/GPU matched spectra agree at six-significant-digit output precision; separate from displayed independent-seed comparison.
figure7_CPU_GPU.hardware: 16-thread CPU versus one V100 with 16 host threads; one GPU per collision is supported.

policy.comparison: All phases at the primary and twice-primary group sizes
policy.choice: Fixed per predefined optics target, not optimized per simulated histogram
policy.uncertainty: Alignment/resolution envelopes are not confidence intervals or seed SEM
policy.physical_scope: Histogram resolution only; particle, mesh, slice and time convergence remain separate

figure12_histogram_resolution.interpretation: Broad-peak noisy maxima and narrow-peak bin broadening were distinct analysis effects. Fixed resolutions and all alignments resolve the histogram advisories; envelopes are numerical sensitivities, not statistical errors. FCC-ee remains far above 1-4 MeV; response fits and simulation convergence remain separate.
